prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Victoria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is launching an aggressive crackdown and will be slapping us with massive fines for leaving bins out even for a second. They’re finally turning our street into a police state just to enforce their ridiculous new rules."
text: I just heard from Mr. Henderson that the council is hiring four extra inspectors to slap us with massive fines for leaving bins out. They are officially turning our street into a police state to enforce these ridiculous new rules!
